name: meshy-mcp
description: Connects Meshy's official MCP server (meshy-mcp-server on PATH, @meshy-ai/meshy-mcp-server 0.5.2, commit 10e882ab) to Claude Code. Ships only this manifest; the MIT server is built from upstream. Asks for your Meshy API key when enabled and keeps it in Claude Code's credential store.

meshy_api_key.title: Meshy API key
meshy_api_key.description: Starts with msy_. Create one at https://www.meshy.ai/settings/api (Pro plan or above).
